crossRefs.note: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good: so we offer…
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…
Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.
For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from…
as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts…
They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.
He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
“He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion…
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

“The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place…
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
“I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
translations.bsb: O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.
translations.kjv: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
translations.asv: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have answered, and will regard him: I am like a green fir-tree; from me is thy fruit found.
